stories.title: Alibaba to issue US$10 billion in new shares for huge AI push amid strong investor demand
stories.summary: Alibaba Group Holding will issue HK$80 billion (US$10.2 billion) worth of new shares and use all of the proceeds to invest in AI, the Chinese tech giant said on Sunday. The move aims to “extend the company’s global AI leadership”, it said, adding that Alibaba would use the funds raised to “invest in its full-stack AI capabilities”, including expanding and enhancing its AI infrastructure. stories.title: Lost in the seat matrix: engineering season begins in Tamil Nadu
stories.summary: Engineering admissions 2026 come during a season of great churn for the education sector in the country. But even without that drama, the crisis in the engineering sector has only exacerbated over the years, with quality concerns, demand and supply mismatch, staff vacancies, and changing trends queering the pitch. In this report, Saptarshi Bhattacharya The Hindu reflects on some of the key and contemporary concerns
